FAQ

What is this page for?

This page helps users review China-based Aerogela listings that match a specific product or application filter.

Are these all direct manufacturers?

Not always. Depending on the taxonomy match, the results may include producers, distributors, or other relevant companies.

How should buyers use this list?

Use it as a starting point for supplier discovery, then inspect each company profile and official website before outreach.
